# checkId: # severity: CRITICAL = money or balance is wrong; HIGH = a core lifecycle step does not happen or is unverifiable; MEDIUM = rule/behaviour deviation; LOW = reporting / hygiene

title: title
expectation: expectation

title: Account creation accepted
expectation: POST /loan-accounts returns 201 for a scenario that is inside product limits

title: Disbursal accepted
expectation: POST /disburse returns 200 and the account becomes ACTIVE with a schedule

title: Account set-up completed without an unexpected error
expectation: every set-up step ran; an unexpected exception is recorded here and the run carries on with the other accounts

title: Secured set-up possible
expectation: LCM has a collateral type and the collateral / facility set-up steps could be started

title: Schedule is internally consistent for the account terms
expectation: count/dates/interest(day count)/balance roll/closing zero/type rules

title: Account EMI amount equals first scheduled instalment
expectation: loan_account.emiAmount matches schedule (EMI-type products)

title: Batch job trigger accepted
expectation: POST /batch-admin/jobs/{job}/trigger accepted for the simulated business date

title: Batch job reaches COMPLETED
expectation: execution reaches terminal COMPLETED within the poll timeout

title: Batch job processes eligible records
expectation: a job that owns accrual / DPD / NPA work reads > 0 records while eligible accounts exist

title: Batch re-run for the same business date is idempotent
expectation: second run for same date neither duplicates accruals nor corrupts state

title: End-of-day run completes and advances the date
expectation: POST /batch-admin/eod/run runs every daily job for the business date and ends ADVANCED

title: Platform business date is in step with the simulated day
expectation: lending-service reports the simulated day as its OPEN business date before the day's work starts

title: End of day moves the business date to the next day
expectation: after end of day the business date is the simulated day + 1 and OPEN

title: Admin portal shows the platform business date
expectation: the admin portal's business date equals lending-service's

title: Daily accrual row exists for every active account
expectation: one accrual row per active account per business date

title: Accrued amount equals principal x rate / day-count basis
expectation: independent calculation on the principal recorded in the row

title: Accrual uses the correct outstanding principal
expectation: recorded principal equals opening or closing principal of the test ledger (per e2e.day.order)

title: No accrual for closed or undisbursed accounts
expectation: no row on or after the closing date

title: Accrued interest reconciles to interest paid at closure
expectation: sum(accruals) within tolerance of sum(interest paid)

title: EMI of the exact amount due is accepted and applied to the oldest unpaid instalment
expectation: 200 and installmentNumber equals the oldest unpaid

title: Payment allocation equals the schedule split
expectation: principalPaid and interestPaid equal the instalment components and add up to the amount

title: Replay of the same Idempotency-Key is safe
expectation: same transaction returned and history not duplicated

title: A short payment is rejected without changing state
expectation: 4xx and schedule/outstanding unchanged

title: Payment history reconciles to the test ledger
expectation: count and totals agree with what the test posted

title: Part-payment reduces principal and re-issues the schedule
expectation: outstanding falls by the amount and the schedule is regenerated and consistent

title: Foreclosure closes the account
expectation: account reaches FORECLOSED/CLOSED with zero outstanding

title: Outstanding principal equals the test ledger after every payment
expectation: admin outstanding principal equals schedule-derived expectation

title: Closed account has zero outstanding
expectation: outstanding principal 0 at closure

title: Fully paid account reaches a closed status
expectation: cohort A accounts end CLOSED (or FORECLOSED when foreclosed)

title: Status transitions are legal
expectation: terminal states never revert; no status for an account that was never disbursed

title: Status equals the bucket for the independently computed DPD
expectation: after the DPD/NPA jobs run for a business date

title: Status ladder is walked without skipping buckets
expectation: rising DPD passes through each lower bucket

title: Cured account returns to ACTIVE once arrears are cleared
expectation: status ACTIVE after the last overdue instalment is paid

title: Admin portal days-past-due follows the platform business date
expectation: admin DPD equals the test's DPD measured at the current business date

title: Past-due unpaid instalments are marked OVERDUE
expectation: schedule row status OVERDUE after the DPD job for that date

title: Account at or beyond the NPA threshold carries an NPA status
expectation: status in NPA family from e2e.dpd.npa-from-days

title: Penal interest on overdue amounts
expectation: API surface exposes penal interest handling

title: Provisioning by asset class
expectation: API surface exposes provisioning

title: Interest suspension / reversal on NPA
expectation: API or accrual data distinguishes suspended interest

title: General ledger / double-entry postings
expectation: API surface exposes journals or GL balances (only an outbox exists)

title: Restructure an account after delinquency
expectation: API surface exposes restructure

title: Write-off of loss assets
expectation: API surface exposes write-off

title: Configurable cure / upgrade rule
expectation: upgrade rule is configurable rather than immediate

title: Partial payment allocation against an instalment
expectation: partial instalment payments accepted and allocated by a documented waterfall

title: DPD / NPA thresholds are configurable
expectation: thresholds are configuration not constants

title: Business-date / EOD rollover service
expectation: a platform business date and an end-of-day rollover exist in the OpenAPI documents

title: Ledger outbox event exists for disbursal and payments
expectation: at least one outbox row per account and per payment event

title: Partition / data-window problems
expectation: calls for the simulated dates succeed (interest_accrual and emi_transaction partitions exist for them)

title: Collateral registered in LCM as DRAFT
expectation: POST /lcm/collateral returns 201 and status DRAFT

title: Collateral cannot be activated while requirements are open
expectation: activate before legal / valuation / charge / insurance is refused with ACTIVATION_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET

title: Collateral becomes ACTIVE once every requirement is met
expectation: legal VERIFIED + approved valuation + charge + insurance then activate gives ACTIVE

title: Facility created and activated by maker-checker
expectation: facility DRAFT then ACTIVE after a different user approves ACTIVATE

title: Collateral allocated to the facility and reported as cover
expectation: allocation 201 and GET collateral-cover covered=true listing the collateral

title: Secured loan is refused without active collateral
expectation: disburse before allocation is refused with COLLATERAL_NOT_COVERED and the account stays PENDING_DISBURSEMENT

title: Secured loan is disbursed once collateral is allocated
expectation: disburse after allocation returns 200 and the account is ACTIVE

title: Disbursement shows on the facility
expectation: facility utilised = drawn = disbursed amount and nothing left reserved

title: Facility utilisation follows the loan every day
expectation: facility utilised = outstanding principal of the test ledger after payments and part-payments

title: A closed loan leaves nothing utilised
expectation: after closure or foreclosure the facility utilised = 0

title: Collateral behind a live loan stays ACTIVE
expectation: the collateral is not released or suspended by end of day or monitoring while a loan uses it

title: Maker-checker is enforced in LCM
expectation: the user who proposed a valuation or a facility change cannot approve it
